question: In the Aspen Plus hydrate-based CO2 capture simulation of the hydrate CCUS review, what discharge pressure does the third compressor have, and to what temperature do the refrigeration units cool the hot stream?
rendered:
According to the document, on page 7, in the Aspen Plus simulation, the specifications for the compressors are listed. The third compressor, COMP3, has a discharge pressure of 0.9 MPa. 

On page 7, in the Aspen Plus simulation, the specifications for the heat exchangers are listed. The refrigeration units, RFG1 and RFG2, cool the hot stream to 4.5 °C.
